EX-99.1 2 ex_1044414.htm EXHIBIT 99.1 ex_1044414.htm Exhibit 99.1 DiaMedica Therapeutics Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Business Highlights ● Enrollment Complete in First Two Cohorts of Phase 2 Early-Onset Fetal Growth Restriction Trial; KOL Event Featuring Preliminary Results Scheduled for November 24 ● ReMEDy2 Phase 2/3 Acute Ischemic Stroke Trial Surpasses 200-Participant Enrollment Threshold; Interim Analysis Expected Q1 2027 ● Conference Call and Webcast November 13 at 8:00 AM Eastern Time / 7:00 AM Central Time Minneapolis, Minnesota – November 12, 2026 (Business Wire) – DiaMedica Therapeutics Inc.

"During the third quarter and recent weeks, we continued to advance DM199 across each of our clinical programs, including completing enrollment in the first two cohorts of our Phase 2 early-onset fetal growth restriction study and reaching the 200-participant enrollment threshold for the planned interim analysis of ReMEDy2," said Rick Pauls, President and Chief Executive Officer of DiaMedica Therapeutics.

We look forward to presenting preliminary results from the first two FGR cohorts at our November 24 key opinion leader (KOL) event and to the ReMEDy2 interim analysis expected in the first quarter of 2027." "Our clinical programs are providing important opportunities to evaluate the pharmacologic effects of DM199 across pregnancy-related vascular disorders and acute ischemic stroke," said Julie Krop, MD, Chief Medical Officer of DiaMedica Therapeutics.

In ReMEDy2, reaching the 200-participant threshold enables the prespecified interim analysis in AIS once the 200th participant completes their 90-day follow-up." Recent Corporate Highlights ● Fetal Growth Restriction Phase 2 Update: Enrollment has been completed in the first two of three planned cohorts of the investigator-sponsored Phase 2 early-onset FGR trial, consisting of 12 participants treated at the 5 µg/kg and 10 µg/kg dose levels.

The event will include preliminary, interim topline results from the first two FGR cohorts and a discussion of FGR, the current treatment landscape and the clinical rationale for evaluating DM199 as a potential treatment in the management of FGR. ● Health Canada Authorizes Global Phase 2 Early-Onset Preeclampsia Study: Following the September 2026 authorization from Health Canada, DiaMedica is preparing to initiate its open-label, Phase 2 dose-finding study in early-onset preeclampsia.

Once these results are completed, DiaMedica plans to submit the data package to FDA for review. ● Acute Ischemic Stroke (AIS) ReMEDy2 Phase 2/3 Clinical Developments: Enrollment in the pivotal Phase 2/3 ReMEDy2 trial (NCT05065216) has reached the prespecified threshold of 200 participants for the trial's planned interim analysis.
The independent Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) will conduct the interim analysis after the 200th participant completes their 90-day follow-up.
DiaMedica will remain blinded to the data at the interim analysis.
Patient recruitment will continue at clinical sites while the 200th participant completes 90-day follow-up and the interim analysis is conducted.
The Company expects the interim analysis to be completed in the first quarter of 2027.
